artifact_under_review: Parent-proposed translation summary; no compiler code or actual executable platform artifacts were supplied for this review.
verdict: Viable as explicit source-preserving paper design after listed corrections; not evidence of operational integration or recovered model parameters.

audit_findings.issue: A blanket LONG/SHORT overlay on every already directional rule is outside the latest requested interpretation and can obscure original hypothesis semantics.
audit_findings.fix: Preserve source-directed originals and explicitly sourced contrary branches. Only genuinely nondirectional structural hypotheses receive labelled LONG/SHORT designs. Missing source-selected signs stay unresolved.

audit_findings.issue: Bank-positive management based on overlay PnL changes the source condition when overlay side differs from source polarity.
audit_findings.fix: Native bank-positive management uses p_current*(mark_at_anchor+h-mark_at_anchor+5)/tick>0. A hypothesis that explicitly changes orientation or management basis requires its own labelled rule. Do not silently replace source predicate with PnL from a differently oriented overlay.

audit_findings.issue: All inputs known is not a complete predicate unless every dependency has an actual availability timestamp. Source-day close and endpoint confirmation do not prove frozen detector identity or absence of a preconfirmation successor.
audit_findings.fix: Use dependency closure and TRUE/FALSE/UNKNOWN logic. UNKNOWN produces retained input-unavailable status. Never treat a missing future link as false. No claimed prospective order until actual event identity/negative-overlap evidence is available.

audit_findings.issue: Fixed-clock NO_ENTRY may be written after retrospective target discovery and incorrectly look like an earlier evaluated decision.
audit_findings.fix: Record planned source time and actual evaluation/record time separately; if target was not knowable at planned time, emit retrospective no-entry diagnostic with no invented earlier snapshot/order.

audit_findings.issue: Delayed first actual decision might move earlier than source entry or rematch a newer predecessor window.
audit_findings.fix: scheduled_floor=original anchor+5; ready=max(scheduled_floor, all dependencies known_by); freeze target/predecessor IDs and source clock anchor for that occurrence. Delayed arm evaluates that occurrence, not a later nearest matching event.

audit_findings.issue: A fill-relative25/55s hold is a new execution design, including when it coincides with source holding length. It is not the source fixed absolute exit.
audit_findings.fix: Keep original anchored exits; identify delayed entry plus fill-relative exit as separate design arms. A missed source exit is not rolled forward silently.

audit_findings.issue: All288pair/triplet modules are syntactic candidate expansion, not proof every one was an observed recurring/source-promoted module. Also they are structural continuation hypotheses without a source trade direction/exit.
audit_findings.fix: Preserve all32pairs+256triplets under common paper protocol. Label named motifs source-mentioned and remaining grammar cells generated design expansion. Keep structural extension outcomes and LONG/SHORT economic overlays as separate outputs.

audit_findings.issue: Prefix watch events do not have a known future current target or its endpoint.
audit_findings.fix: Prefix recipe anchors to final prefix member maturity/known_by; never use later completed-chain identity to start the watch or trade. Watch completion is an outcome. Prefix execution timing is new design.

audit_findings.issue: Posthoc exact depth, terminal duration, CHOP_ROTATION, timing mixture class or eventual FLIP/SAME could enter early predicates via cohort selection.
audit_findings.fix: Execution candidate discovery must not filter by these outcomes. Keep them only in retrospective report joins. Explicit causal forecast operands can gate separate forecast hypotheses when model/version/known_by are bound.

audit_findings.issue: Historical tape ends and canonical next-stage boundaries are retrospective; exiting at last observed trade beforehand uses future knowledge.
audit_findings.fix: Use causal scheduled/observed exit requests. If tape ends before fill or exit, retain censored/no-fill/open-unmarked outcome. Do not force a mark at retrospectively selected last trade and call it an executable exit.

audit_findings.issue: Uniformity can collapse hypotheses with distinct populations or omit nonexecution states.
audit_findings.fix: Keep canonical679, fixed-focused3429, exact-depth label cohorts, and all candidate events separate. Share execution/reporting protocol, not population redefinition. Every row retains adverse/flat/unknown/censored/late/no-fill/rejected outcomes, with no performance admission.

three_valued_logic.AND: FALSE if any operand FALSE; TRUE if all TRUE; otherwise UNKNOWN
three_valued_logic.UNKNOWN: retained INPUT_UNAVAILABLE; never coerce to false or zero
three_valued_logic.known_by: derived value cannot precede max(all lawful dependency times) including identity, model evaluation and transform completion

operand_and_clock_contract.allowed_forecast_substitutes: Explicit forecast names with causal snapshot hash, immutable prediction timestamp, model/head/view/version and declared probability decision condition; NEVER alias true labels into forecast fields.
operand_and_clock_contract.canonical_event_identity: Actual frozen-detector identity_available_at, not t0 or endpoint confirmation. Remains unresolved absent proof. Full-day threshold closure is necessary but not sufficient to establish global prominence/refractory selection.
operand_and_clock_contract.negative_overlap: Source asks no next canonical event starts at or before current confirmation. Live absence requires actual lawful negative evidence; a null next_event link is not proof. If unproved, original source arm is UNKNOWN. A causal streaming-detector no-observed-successor arm is separate changed-detector design.
operand_and_clock_contract.seed: max(event identity known_by, t0+60, every contributing observed input/transform known_by); predecessor seed-state S is not same-polarity S.
operand_and_clock_contract.source_history_wall: predecessor endpoint_confirmation+60<=current t0 is source eligibility comparison. Actual history feature availability additionally must be <=actual decision. For original fixed-clock arm, all used inputs must be available at planned entry.
operand_and_clock_contract.frozen_history_feature_cells: signed displacement,MFE,MAE at predecessor confirmation+[5,10,20,30,60], finite/uncensored and predecessor next_same_polarity known. This belongs to frozen source arm; do not replace by merely t0+60 seed maturity.

recipes.unspecified_source_direction: Retain UNRESOLVED_DIRECTION for a cell whose source-selected sign is unbound. Do not fabricate a sign or install blanket opposite-direction control.
recipes.source_vs_design: Alphabet/order/depth/optional relation/exits are source family. Delayed fill-hold is new design. Preserve recovered source direction; no blanket LONG/SHORT additions to directional originals.

recipes.deduplication: Shared computation allowed, but references to overlapping exact-search cells retained. Do not count the same economic fill twice in an aggregate portfolio merely because two source lists name it; independent hypothesis results remain separate.

recipes.axes: Both source clock anchors and fixed/delayed timing axes; SOURCE_DIRECTED only. Native DOC_ONSET/SOURCE_FIXED/SOURCE_DIRECTED remains identifiable as documented frozen play.
recipes.not_a_depth_label: Four immediate predecessor seeds, never predicate exact_D4.

recipes.population: canonical679 source population is evidence ledger, not replacement for focused3429; prospective candidate generation uses canonical-sequence semantics with lawful identity

recipes.native_fixed_clock_request: At anchor+bank_offset_s evaluate condition; if TRUE request exit, else maintain normal anchor+60 exit. UNKNOWN -> retain MANAGEMENT_INPUT_UNAVAILABLE and preserve already-specified normal exit; never retroactively substitute a mark.
recipes.delayed_counterpart: New paper-design applies banking check at fill+(bank_offset_s-5)s, default exit fill+55s. Source-oriented reference-return basis at fill-relative time is also a design reinterpretation and must not be labelled original fixed-checkpoint proxy.
recipes.late_source_checkpoint: If delayed entry occurs after original source bank time, do not apply a pre-entry profit measurement to the newly opened position as if earned by it. Either source checkpoint is INAPPLICABLE_ALREADY_PASSED or use separately labelled fill-relative proxy.
recipes.non_default_design_alternative: Own-position-PnL banking is documented here only as a possible differently defined experiment; do not instantiate it by default.

recipes.no_backdating: R30/R60 path class becomes known at completed exit; R120/R300 never enter the earlier parent decision. Labels computed separately under each source anchor, not merged.
recipes.execution_overlay_design: After parent flat and R30/R60 class actually known, optional LONG/SHORT recovery-test positions may enter at first decision after max(flat_confirmed_at,path_class_known_by), with25/55s fill-relative hold as explicit new design. Keep ALL four classes and other/unknown as outcomes; do not select only shallow. Native source role remains watch, not entry.

recipes.count_note: 32pairs+256triplets before optional absolute polarity strata or economic overlays; no permutation invariance.
recipes.asof_membership: Ordered consecutive known canonical members; first source-recognizable match requires all module seeds, identities and relative polarities available. Use no strict-D2+ future filter in live matching.
source_structural_reporting: recurrence across strict all-model-positive source lineages

trade_overlay.entry: first actual decision after all member dependency known_by times
trade_overlay.provenance: new paper-design economic overlay on structural module; no source trade exit was prescribed

recipes.remaining_generated_modules: symmetrical grammar expansion, retained with explicit design provenance; do not label all as empirically recurring

recipes.dependencies: every prefix member identity, seed and polarity; no future completed target needed
recipes.completion_outcome: Later next compatible state/current event completes target pattern after anchor; observed failure, replacement, weekly censoring and no completion all retained.

trade_overlay.source_directed: source watch has no trade side; do not borrow a future target polarity
trade_overlay.provenance: new paper-design; original prefix remains watch-state candidate

recipes.candidate_generation: All causally discovered candidate/predecessor occurrences; NEVER prefilter by eventual exact depth. Preserve exact-D0 and censored controls.
required_forecast_binding: immutable lock-rule revision and exact thresholds
recipes.clock: Evaluate every causal second; freeze first lock. PRIOR/T0/H assigned after scoring using canonical target t0. Old finite grids retained as comparison history, not current V4 signal search.
recipes.entry: first actual decision after sealed first-lock signal is available
recipes.exit_design: fill+25s or55s for common economic overlays; independently preserve any exact source-defined exits if recovered
recipes.no_source_threshold_invention: Lock thresholds/model parameters absent in reviewed proposals. Without binding, retain UNBOUND_FORECAST/NO_ENTRY and every outcome row. Do not substitute realized label or retrospectively first-correct second.
recipes.depth_and_shape_reporting: For origin i, D=max consecutive d starting1 such that all ridge/extra_trees/knn full-view structural OOT incremental_gain(d,target=i+d)>0; first missing or nonpositive model gain ends the consecutive prefix. Exact-Dd means maximum consensus depth equals d, not merely d predecessors.
recipes.timing_family_targets: Frozen GMM model classes only; means are not nearest-center rules. Posthoc GMM labels do not enter live predicate; separate causal forecast required.

recipes.population: Authoritative master ledger exactly3429, futureFLIP1546/SAME1883; never enumerate canonicalPOX adjacency as substitute.
recipes.live_candidate_gate: Needs independently defined honest candidate universe and causal membership forecast or actual lawful identity; master future case IDs alone are oracle cohort, not signal.
recipes.future_branch_handling: FLIP/SAME truth only scoring until actual label_revealed_at. Early branch-conditioned execution requires causal forecast with immutable model/lock; no backdating.
recipes.execution_overlays: Preserve source-directed initial continuation where defined. Nondirectional branch-state hypotheses may get labelled LONG/SHORT designs only after their causal trigger is independently specified. Missing lawful input produces retained INPUT_UNAVAILABLE.

shared_execution_protocol.scope: PAPER only; independent virtual ledger per hypothesis/version/clock/timing/side arm; same fill/cost/rejection/report schema for every arm
shared_execution_protocol.signal_id: hash(source family + version + canonical or causal occurrence IDs + predicate revision + clock variant + timing variant + side arm + parameter tuple)
shared_execution_protocol.duplicate_policy: At most one entry per signal_id; overlapping source candidates remain separate hypotheses. Any aggregate portfolio exposure/dedup policy is separate from per-arm reporting and must not silently delete cases.
shared_execution_protocol.fill_ordering: Use actual observed event/receive/sequence order. Do not sort within-second trades by price, backfill a predecision price, or reinterpret source carried marks as broker fills.
shared_execution_protocol.symbol_tick: Resolve instrument identity and source tick=0.001 for original NG price math; platform instrument mapping must be pinned. Retain roll/source differences.
shared_execution_protocol.costs: Same predefined fee/spread/slippage treatment and same stress grid for every arm; source gross marks kept separate from actual paper simulation.
shared_execution_protocol.tape_boundary: Censored if entry/exit cannot be observed or filled before available tape ends; no retrospective liquidation at last trade unless explicitly labelled valuation-only.
shared_execution_protocol.admission: No historical return/sign/pvalue/sample count/fold success/novelty-overlap ranking or exclusion. Source-specific causal predicates remain distinct.

unresolved_sources.impact: No canonical prospective order can truthfully use a historical t0 as event knowledge. Endpoint confirmation, source-day close, and event mark are distinct.
unresolved_sources.resolution: Instrument or bind a proven first-known event stream; alternatively define separate replay detector, with new identity and changed population explicitly declared.

unresolved_sources.item: Causal first-lock model, frozen coefficients, thresholds and maturity/reveal rules
unresolved_sources.impact: Continuous V4 contract specifies architecture and ledgers, not one exact trading signal.
unresolved_sources.resolution: Bind exact existing model artifacts or declare new paper-design model and lock choices; keep every candidate without performance admission.

unresolved_sources.item: Exact GMM fitted weights, covariance, scaler and trained cohorts
unresolved_sources.impact: Source code describes training; centers alone do not reproduce timing or shape assignments.
unresolved_sources.resolution: Bind frozen trained model artifact hashes or leave historical labels as supplied; do not nearest-center substitute.

unresolved_sources.item: Prefix, range/fade/rotation, survival/hazard, extension-to-order rule math
unresolved_sources.impact: Sources identify opportunity/state hypotheses but do not choose executable thresholds, side or exit.
unresolved_sources.resolution: Declare concrete new paper-design contracts separately from source original semantics. All should receive common testing, including contrary branches.

unresolved_sources.item: Focused3429 master identities and reveal metadata
unresolved_sources.impact: Canonical679 cannot substitute; future branch identity cannot enter first trade.
unresolved_sources.resolution: Bind fixed ledger artifact and candidate control universe.

unresolved_sources.item: Source input manifests and platform adapter/fill semantics
unresolved_sources.impact: Original gross last-trade marks do not establish actionable broker fills; byte-exact detector inputs, tick mapping, session, event/receive/source ordering need binding.
unresolved_sources.resolution: Use shared platform paper adapter and retained no-fill/late/error statuses; label common operational choices.

coverage_assertions.side_overlay_scope: Only nondirectional structural/module/prefix/state hypotheses; no blanket opposite-side controls on directional originals.

provenance: All source refs resolve to byte-verified receipts in review_chain.json. These recipes distinguish source facts from new paper-design choices and leave unbound forecasts/detector marks explicit. No refit, worker, suite, migration, agent or parent-artifact mutation performed.

current_direction_policy.source_direction_defined: Instantiate the original source-directed side. Do not add blanket LONG/SHORT controls to that directional hypothesis.
current_direction_policy.source_explicit_contrary_branches: Preserve each explicit source contrary orientation/branch under its own original semantics.
current_direction_policy.structural_hypothesis_has_no_trade_side: Use labelled LONG and SHORT paper-design arms for nondirectional modules/prefixes/structural state forecasts; same inclusion and reporting.
current_direction_policy.source_selected_direction_missing: UNRESOLVED_DIRECTION input/implementation status; do not infer a sign from evaluation outcomes and do not pretend absence of recovered source sign means the source was nondirectional.
current_direction_policy.not_identical_orders: Same inclusion/process/reporting retains natural hypothesis differences in direction, trigger, clock, lifecycle and exits.

expression_dsl.literal: {const:value}; bare primitive args also mean constants, never field names.
expression_dsl.field: {field:name}; resolve typed value and known_by from immutable as-of snapshot; absent or not-yet-available -> UNKNOWN.
expression_dsl.op: {op:name,args:[...]}; supported and/or/eq/lt/lte/gt/gte/mul/div/sub/add_seconds/all; all binds item for each list member; arithmetic propagates UNKNOWN and div byzero is UNKNOWN.
expression_dsl.source_mark_price_at: Latest source-defined causal last-trade mark actually available at requested timestamp, preserving proper source/tape order; carries its observation timestamp. Never prospective broker fill.
expression_dsl.polarity_in_named_stratum: ALL=true; UP means polarity=+1; DOWN means polarity=-1; missing polarity -> UNKNOWN.
expression_dsl.passes_frozen_lock_rule: Resolve actual frozen predicate by immutable rule ID. Missing rule/threshold/model receipt -> UNKNOWN; do not invent threshold or evaluate using outcome.
expression_dsl.chronology: No field semantic_kind=posthoc_outcome/oracle_cohort can enter earlier live predicate; diagnostic/classification expressions are explicitly named separately.
